references.text: Aaron and his sons shall eat what remains of the grain offering. It shall be eaten unleavened in a holy place, in the court of the tent of meeting.
The priest who offers the sin offering shall eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place, in the court of the tent of meeting.
Every male among the priests may eat of it. It shall be eaten in a holy place. It is most holy.
What remains of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons. It is most holy, part of the Lord's food offerings by fire.
The breads shall belong to Aaron and his sons. They shall eat them in a holy place, for they are most holy. This is his portion from the Lord's food offerings by fire, a permanent ordinance.

This shall be yours from the most holy gifts that are not burned: all their offerings, grain offerings, sin offerings, and guilt offerings that they give to me. It is most holy for you and your sons. You shall eat it in a most holy place.
